lines.text: Many learners say: I am too happy to see you.
Better: I am so happy to see you.
So! I am so glad to meet you.

data.wrong: I am too happy to see you.
data.right: I am so happy to see you.

quiz.stem: I am ___ glad to meet you.

native.hook: too 带有“太过头”的意思！
native.tip: 中文的“太高兴了”里，“太”只是强调。英语的 too 表示“过头、不好”，想强调开心要用 so 或 very。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I am too happy to see you.”😅 中文“太”只是强调，英语 too 表示过头：“I am so happy to see you.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“I am so happy to see you.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: The Chinese word for too can just mean very, but English too means too much. Use so.
en.caption: Do you say “I am too happy to see you.” 😅 Too means too much, so use so: “I am so happy to see you.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
